decisions.reason: Conferencing demand rose with remote work, but Teams and Zoom have commoditised it and it has disappeared from the website since 2018, so it falls below aspirations; slack from expansion lets the firm carry it a little longer, though it is a prime pruning candidate.

The metro data centre network shows concrete adoption by financial customers and fits the high-bandwidth data centre strategy, so results exceed aspirations and there is no trigger for problemistic search.
Optical spectrum services use the owned fibre and serve the strategic push toward high-bandwidth infrastructure, keeping performance in line with aspirations.
The number ordering portal is a cheap self-service tool that supports real-time provisioning, although it may be folded into broader customer portals over time.
Carrier pre-selection is a legacy service in a shrinking market that falls clearly below aspirations, so problemistic search points to moving its resources to software-defined and cloud connectivity.
